name: Namaste (Hello)
description: Two hands pressed together vertically in front of chest in prayer gesture — the universal Indian greeting.
poseGuide: Bring both open palms together facing each other with fingers pointing up.

name: Welcome
description: Both open hands with palms facing upward moving gently toward the chest.
poseGuide: Extend both open palms facing upward and sweep them inward toward your body.

name: Thank You
description: Flat hand moving from chin forward, or both hands in a gentle respectful bow.
poseGuide: Touch fingertips to chin and move forward, or join both palms in gratitude.

name: Please
description: Both open hands cupped slightly in front of chest, or open palm circling over chest.
poseGuide: Cup both palms slightly upward in front of your chest in a polite request.

name: Sorry
description: Closed fist rubbing in a circular motion over the center of the chest.
poseGuide: Form an 'A' fist and make gentle clockwise circles over your chest.

name: Nice to meet you
description: Both index fingers pointing upward moving from sides to meet in front of chest.
poseGuide: Extend index fingers on both hands and bring them together in the center.

name: Help
description: Left hand open flat palm facing up; Right hand in fist with thumb up placed on the left palm.
poseGuide: Place your right thumb-up fist firmly on your left flat open palm.

name: Water
description: W-hand shape (index, middle, ring finger up) or cupped hand brought to lips.
poseGuide: Extend three fingers (index, middle, ring) and bring them close to mouth.

name: Food / Eat
description: Fingertips brought together into a point and tapped twice near the mouth.
poseGuide: Pinch all fingertips together toward thumb and tap near your mouth.

name: Thirsty / Drink
description: Hand shaped like a cup tilting back toward open mouth.
poseGuide: Form a 'C' cup shape and tilt it toward your mouth as if drinking.

name: House / Home
description: Both hands angled at 45 degrees touching fingertips to form the peak of a roof.
poseGuide: Bring flat palms together at an angle so fingertips meet like a roof triangle.

name: Book / Study
description: Both flat hands joined at pinkies opening outward like the pages of a book.
poseGuide: Place palms together facing up with pinkies touching, then open and close.

name: School / College
description: Both flat hands clapping together horizontally twice.
poseGuide: Clap your flat right palm on top of your flat left palm twice.

name: Family
description: Both hands forming circles with thumbs and indices, starting together and sweeping outward into a circle.
poseGuide: Form 'F' or pinch circles with both hands and draw an enclosing circle.

name: Friend
description: Both index fingers hooked together in interlocking friendship sign.
poseGuide: Curve both index fingers like hooks and lock them together.

name: Doctor / Hospital
description: Right hand index and middle fingers placed on left inner wrist checking pulse.
poseGuide: Hold left forearm out and tap inner wrist with right index and middle fingers.

name: Time / Watch
description: Right index finger tapping the top of left wrist where a wristwatch is worn.
poseGuide: Tap your left wrist twice with your right index finger.

name: Work / Job
description: Both hands in fists, right wrist tapping on top of left wrist twice.
poseGuide: Make two closed fists and tap the right wrist down on the left wrist.

name: Bathroom / Washroom
description: T-hand shape (thumb between index and middle fingers) shaking side to side.
poseGuide: Tuck thumb between index and middle finger and gently shake hand.

name: Come
description: Open hand with palm facing inward gesturing toward the chest.
poseGuide: Beckon inward with an open palm or index finger toward your chest.

name: Go
description: Index finger or open palm pointing and moving firmly outward.
poseGuide: Point your index finger forward away from your body.

name: I / Me
description: Index finger pointing directly at the center of the signer's chest.
poseGuide: Point your right index finger to your own chest.

name: You
description: Index finger pointing directly toward the conversation partner.
poseGuide: Point your index finger toward the camera or person.

name: We / Us
description: Index finger pointing to right shoulder then sweeping across to left shoulder.
poseGuide: Touch right shoulder with index finger and arc across to left shoulder.

name: What
description: Both hands open with palms facing upward shaking side to side questioning.
poseGuide: Hold both open palms up at waist level and shake gently side to side.

name: Where
description: Both hands open with palms facing outward moving in inquiring side sweeps.
poseGuide: Extend both hands with palms facing forward, swaying gently outwards.

name: Why
description: Index finger touching temple or forehead and pulling away with bent fingers.
poseGuide: Touch temple with right fingertips and draw hand away while bending fingers.

name: How
description: Both hands with backs of fingers together rotating palms upward.
poseGuide: Place knuckles together facing down, then roll palms outward and upward.

name: Yes
description: Thumb up or fist nodding up and down from the wrist like a head nod.
poseGuide: Extend thumb upward firmly or nod closed fist up and down.

name: No
description: Index and middle finger snapping quickly shut against the thumb, or thumb down.
poseGuide: Thumb down or snap index and middle fingers together onto thumb.

name: Good / Super
description: Thumb and index finger forming a circle with three fingers extended upward.
poseGuide: Form 'OK' circle with thumb and index while keeping other 3 fingers straight.

name: Bad
description: Thumb pointing straight down or palm flicking downward dismissively.
poseGuide: Point your thumb down with fingers closed into a fist.

name: Happy
description: Both open palms brushing upward across the chest in quick joyful motions.
poseGuide: Hold both open palms against chest and brush upward twice.

name: Sad
description: Open hand with fingers spread drawing slowly down in front of the face.
poseGuide: Hold open hand in front of face and draw it down slowly.

name: Understand
description: Index finger flicking quickly upward next to forehead like a lightbulb turning on.
poseGuide: Hold fist near forehead and flick index finger upward.

name: Wait
description: Both open hands held out with palms up wiggling fingers in place.
poseGuide: Hold both palms up in front of you and wiggle fingers gently.

name: Emergency
description: Both hands with spread fingers waving urgently back and forth in front of chest.
poseGuide: Wave both spread hands urgently side to side in front of your chest.

name: Stop
description: Both hands raised vertically with flat open palms facing forward signaling halt.
poseGuide: Hold both flat open palms vertical facing straight forward toward camera.

name: Pain / Hurt
description: Both index fingers pointing toward each other twisting back and forth sharply.
poseGuide: Point both index fingers toward each other and twist wrists sharply.

name: Danger
description: Strict warning gesture with raised index finger shaking firmly.
poseGuide: Raise your right index finger vertically and shake firmly with serious posture.

name: Zero (0)
description: O-shape formed with thumb and all fingertips touching.
poseGuide: Touch thumb to all finger tips forming an oval zero.

name: One (1)
description: Single index finger pointing vertically upward.
poseGuide: Extend your index finger upward with thumb and other fingers closed.

name: Two (2)
description: Index and middle fingers extended upward in V-shape.
poseGuide: Raise index and middle fingers in a clear 'V' sign.

name: Three (3)
description: Thumb, index, and middle fingers extended.
poseGuide: Extend thumb, index, and middle fingers with ring and pinky folded.

name: Four (4)
description: Four fingers raised upright with thumb folded across palm.
poseGuide: Hold index, middle, ring, and pinky straight up with thumb tucked.

name: Five (5)
description: All five digits fully spread and extended open.
poseGuide: Open your palm completely with all five fingers spread out.
